# Prétraitements classiques

## Colonnes utiles

```{r}
#CréATION variable age simplifiée (age_CY : "adult" ou numéros = juveniles)
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_CY == "adult" ~ "adult",
      !is.na(age_CY) & age_CY != "adult" ~ "juvenile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
table(DATA_ALL$age_group, useNA = "ifany") 


# ADD column "MIGRATION" spring / autumn
DATA_ALL$date <- as.Date(DATA_ALL$timestamp)
DATA_ALL$date <- as.Date(DATA_ALL$date)
#DATA_ALL$date

DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# data_sub5
#CréATION variable age simplifiée (age_CY : "adult" ou numéros = juveniles)
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_CY == "adult" ~ "adult",
      !is.na(age_CY) & age_CY != "adult" ~ "juvenile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
table(data_sub5$age_group, useNA = "ifany") 


# ADD column "MIGRATION" spring / autumn
data_sub5$date <- as.Date(data_sub5$timestamp)
data_sub5$date <- as.Date(data_sub5$date)
#data_sub5$date

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",

    )
  )
```

## Délimitation de la zone

```{r}
# Création de la  zone_interet
ecoregions <- st_read(here( "Alice/Data_analysis_June_2026/Ecoregions2017/Ecoregions2017.shp"), wkt_filter = st_as_text( st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c( xmin = -20, xmax = 60, ymin = 0, ymax = 40 ), crs = 4326)) ) ) 
names(ecoregions) 
#unique(ecoregions$BIOME_NAME)
#unique(ecoregions$ECO_NAME)

desert <- ecoregions[ecoregions$BIOME_NAME == "Deserts & Xeric Shrublands", ] 
plot(desert["BIOME_NAME"])

sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(sahara["BIOME_NAME"])

tibesti_sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara|Tibesti-Jebel Uweinat", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(tibesti_sahara["BIOME_NAME"])

pts_sf <- st_as_sf(DATA_ALL, coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"), crs = 4326)

coords <- st_coordinates(pts_sf)
# coords[,1] = longitude, coords[,2] = latitude
lat <- coords[,2]
intersects_vec <- apply(st_intersects(pts_sf, tibesti_sahara, sparse = FALSE), 1, any)

pts_sf$Zone_interet <- ifelse(
  (lat >= 17.51 & lat <= 26.0) | intersects_vec,
  "Zone_interet",
  NA
)
unique(pts_sf$Zone_interet)
# Check
tab <- table(pts_sf$Zone_interet, useNA = "ifany")
# proportion
prop <- tab / sum(tab) * 100
prop
# Add Zone_interet to data
DATA_ALL$Zone_interet <- pts_sf$Zone_interet
unique(DATA_ALL$Zone_interet)


# Jeu de donnée séparé

#Mise en facteur
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  mutate(across(c(
    Zone_interet, age_group, individual.local.identifier, MIGRATION
  ), as.factor))
table(DATA_ALL$Zone_interet)

# Séléction Zone_interet
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(!is.na(Zone_interet))
unique(DATA_ALL$Zone_interet)
```

## Base comparable de trajectoire

```{r}
# Projection métrique et normalisation
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  group_by(bird_year) %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    dist_cum = cumsum(replace_na(ddist_2D, 0)),
    dist_norm = dist_cum / max(dist_cum)
  )
```

## Interpolations

```{r}

# Interpoler les trajectoires sur une grille commune
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100)

interp_traj <- function(df) {
  data.frame(
    dist_norm = grid,
    x = approx(df$dist_norm, df$x, xout = grid, rule = 2)$y,
    y = approx(df$dist_norm, df$y, xout = grid, rule = 2)$y
  )
}

# Créer la liste de trajectoires par individu + saison
traj_list <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(!is.na(MIGRATION), !is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, MIGRATION, bird_year) %>%
  group_split()

# Interpoler toutes les trajectoires
traj_list_interp <- lapply(traj_list, interp_traj)

# Calculer la distance moyenne entre les migrations d'un même individu
traj_dist <- function(t1, t2) {
  mean(sqrt((t1$x - t2$x)^2 + (t1$y - t2$y)^2))
}

pairwise_dist <- function(trajs) {
  if(length(trajs) < 2) return(NA)
  combn(seq_along(trajs), 2, function(idx) {
    traj_dist(trajs[[idx[1]]], trajs[[idx[2]]])
  }) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

## Visualisation des anomalies

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# Retrait de Charline
# Demi-tour au Nord de l'Algérie à : 2025-05-10 15:00
# Mais pause avant, vers 13h. Donc on coupe à 2025-05-10 13:00
# Départ migration automne 2025 2025-09-24 10:00
# => Donc estivage de 2025-05-10 13:00 à 2025 2025-09-24 10:00


# verif 1 : Charline
start_time <- as.POSIXct("2025-05-10 13:00:00", tz = "UTC")
end_time   <- as.POSIXct("2025-09-24 10:00:00", tz = "UTC")
data_verif <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(
    timestamp >= start_time &
    timestamp <= end_time
  )

ggplot(data_verif, aes(x = x, y = y, group = individual.local.identifier, color = age_group)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "darkorange1",
    "adult" = "darkorchid2"   
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


# verif 2 : Mina
data_verif2 <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(
    country == "Tunisia"
  )

ggplot(data_verif2, aes(x = x, y = y, group = individual.local.identifier, color = age_group)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "darkorange1",
    "adult" = "darkorchid2"    
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
# => C'est Mina de Rians en Tunisie spring 2023
```

## Découpe et jdd par saison et age_group

```{r}

# Découpe des anomalies DATA_ALL

# Charline
start_time <- as.POSIXct("2025-05-10 13:00:00", tz = "UTC")
end_time   <- as.POSIXct("2025-09-24 10:00:00", tz = "UTC")
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL[
  !(
    DATA_ALL$timestamp >= start_time &
    DATA_ALL$timestamp <= end_time &
    DATA_ALL$individual.local.identifier == "Charline de la Grisonnière"
  ),
]
# Mina
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL[
  !(
    DATA_ALL$country == "Tunisia" &
    DATA_ALL$individual.local.identifier == "Mina de Rians"
  ),
]

# Par saison
DATA_ALL_spring <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(MIGRATION == "spring")
DATA_ALL_autumn <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(MIGRATION == "autumn")

# Par age_group
#Juvenile
DATA_ALL_spring_juv <- DATA_ALL_spring %>%
  filter(age_group == "juvenile")
DATA_ALL_autumn_juv <- DATA_ALL_autumn %>%
  filter(age_group == "juvenile")
# Adult
DATA_ALL_spring_ad <- DATA_ALL_spring %>%
  filter(age_group == "adult")
DATA_ALL_autumn_ad <- DATA_ALL_autumn %>%
  filter(age_group == "adult")
```

## Identification des pauses

```{r}
# Placement des sites sans mouvement "sit"
# move_2 : Bird in flight or perched v2 (determined using ground speed thresholds plus assigning all HF positions > 50 m a.g.l. as in-flight): "move" or "sit"

# DATA_ALL
# Séquences de "sit" pour les vraies pauses
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier) %>%
  mutate(
    is_sit = move_2 == "sit",
    sit_block = cumsum(is_sit != lag(is_sit, default = first(is_sit)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# Calculer la durée de chaque bloc de sit
sit_summary <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(is_sit) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, sit_block, daynight_0) %>%
  summarise(
    duration_min = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "mins")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Grader que les blocs > 10min
valid_sit_all <- sit_summary %>%
  filter(duration_min >= 10)
# Récupérer les points corréspondants
DATA_sit_long_all <- DATA_ALL %>%
  inner_join(valid_sit_all,
             by = c("individual.local.identifier", "sit_block"))

# DATA_ALL_spring
# Séquences de "sit" pour les vraies pauses
```

# Trajectoires par saison

## Spring

```{r}
##### Carte avec biome : Tout est converti en sf

# Tout convertir en sf propre
pts_sf <- st_as_sf(
  DATA_ALL_spring,
  coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"),
  crs = 4326
)
sit_sf <- st_as_sf(
  DATA_sit_long_spring,
  coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

# Age_group
pts_sf <- pts_sf %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_CY == "adult" ~ "adult",
      !is.na(age_CY) & age_CY != "adult" ~ "juvenile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Trajectoires en sf
lines_sf <- pts_sf %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp) %>%   # adapter si besoin
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, segment_id, age_group) %>%
  summarise(do_union = FALSE) %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")
lines_sf$age_group <- as.factor(lines_sf$age_group)

# DENSITÉ (remplacement de stat_density_2d)

# Grille : kernel density raster
library(MASS)
coords <- st_coordinates(pts_sf)
k <- kde2d(coords[,1], coords[,2], n = 200)

# transformer en raster sf-compatible
library(terra)
r <- rast(k)
crs(r) <- st_crs(pts_sf)$wkt

# convertir en sf pour ggplot
dens_sf <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE)
names(dens_sf) <- c("x", "y", "density")



## Coupe et plot

tibesti_sahara_proj <- st_transform(tibesti_sahara, 4326)

# Coupe
cut_line <- st_sfc(
  st_linestring(matrix(
    c(5, -90,
      5,  90),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  )),
  crs = 4326
)
cut_line <- st_buffer(cut_line, 0)
zone_west <- st_difference(

#### ----------- GEOFENCES -----------

make_band <- function(lat_min, lat_max, xmin = -20, xmax = 5) {
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(xmin, lat_min,

)

  ) +

    data = subset(pts_sf, daynight_0 == "night"),
    color = "black",
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  coord_sf() +

  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)

summary(sit_sf)
unique(pts_sf$age_group)

#### Recode experience (remplace age_group, adult/juvenile -> >=5 / <=3 yrs) ----
pts_sf <- pts_sf %>%
  mutate(experience = factor(
    ifelse(age_group == "adult", ">= 5 yrs", "<= 3 yrs"),
    levels = c(">= 5 yrs", "<= 3 yrs")
  ))

lines_sf <- pts_sf %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, segment_id, experience) %>%
  summarise(do_union = FALSE) %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")

#### Stopovers : sit_sf déjà filtré à >= 10 min, on distingue juste jour/nuit ----
stopovers_sf <- sit_sf %>%
  mutate(stopover_type = factor(
    ifelse(daynight_0 == "night", "Roost", "Stopover > 10 min"),
    levels = c("Roost", "Stopover > 10 min")
  ))

#### PLOT (sans densité, avec experience + stopovers) ---------------------
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = zone_crop,
    fill = NA,
    color = "azure2",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = bands_sf,
    fill = "lemonchiffon1",
    color = "lemonchiffon1",
    linewidth = 1,
    linetype = "solid",
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  # trajectoires, colorées par expérience
  geom_sf(
    data = lines_sf,
    aes(color = experience),
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Experience",
    values = c(">= 5 yrs" = "#00693F", "<= 3 yrs" = "#C96A00")
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  # stopovers : dortoirs (noir) + pauses > 10 min (bleu)
  geom_sf(
    data = stopovers_sf,
    aes(color = stopover_type),
    shape = 18,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Stopovers",
    values = c("Roost" = "black", "Stopover > 10 min" = "blue")
  ) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
make_band <- function(lat_min, lat_max, xmin = -20, xmax = 5) {
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(xmin, lat_min,
      xmax, lat_min,
      xmax, lat_max,
      xmin, lat_max,
      xmin, lat_min),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  )))
}

bands <- st_sfc(
  make_band(17.51, 18.584),
  make_band(20.913, 21.964),
  make_band(24.239, 25.265),
  make_band(27.754, 28.749),
  make_band(31.271, 32.232),
  crs = 4326
)

bands_sf <- st_sf(geofence = factor(1:5), geometry = bands)
```

```{r}
unique(pts_sf$age_group)

#### Recode experience (remplace age_group, adult/juvenile -> >=5 / <=3 yrs) ----

  mutate(experience = factor(
    ifelse(age_group == "adult", ">= 5 yrs", "<= 3 yrs"),

  ))

lines_sf <- pts_sf %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp) %>%

#### Stopovers : sit_sf déjà filtré à >= 10 min, on distingue juste jour/nuit ----
str(sit_sf)
stopovers_sf <- sit_sf %>%
  mutate(stopover_type = factor(
    ifelse(daynight_0.y == "night", "Roost", "Stopover > 10 min"),

  ))

#### PLOT (sans densité, avec experience + stopovers) ---------------------

  geom_sf(
    data = zone_crop,
    fill = NA,
    color = "azure2",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = bands_sf,
    fill = "lemonchiffon1",
    color = "lemonchiffon1",

    linetype = "solid",
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  # trajectoires, colorées par expérience
  geom_sf(
    data = lines_sf,
    aes(color = experience),
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Experience",
    values = c(">= 5 yrs" = "#00693F", "<= 3 yrs" = "#C96A00")
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  # stopovers : dortoirs (noir) + pauses > 10 min (bleu)
  geom_sf(
    data = stopovers_sf,
    aes(color = stopover_type),
    shape = 18,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Stopovers",
    values = c("Roost" = "black", "Stopover > 10 min" = "blue")
  ) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Régularité par zone (grille spatiale)

Indice de régularité = **Distance moyenne entre les trajectoires d’un même individu, pour une saison donnée.** On compare les trajectoires **au même moment.** Aussi, il faut prendre en compte dans quel sens est cette distance, si on est décalé à droite, à gauche.

## Spring

### delta_lon

```{r}

# 1. Conversion en sf (ATTENTION à l’ordre : longitude puis latitude)
DATA_ALL_spring <- st_as_sf(
  DATA_ALL_spring,
  coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

# 2. Séquence de latitudes
lat_seq <- seq(17, 34, by = 0.01)

# 3. Fonction d’interpolation
interp_track <- function(df, lat_seq) {
  
  # extraire coordonnées depuis geometry
  coords <- st_coordinates(df)
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      lon = coords[,1],  # X = longitude
      lat = coords[,2]   # Y = latitude
    ) %>%
    arrange(lat)  # ordre du sud vers le nord
  
  data.frame(
    lat = lat_seq,
    lon = approx(df$lat, df$lon, xout = lat_seq, rule = 2)$y
  )
}

# 4. Interpolation par individu et année
tracks_interp <- DATA_ALL_spring %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, year, age_group) %>%
  group_modify(~ interp_track(.x, lat_seq)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 5. Trajectoire de référence (première année)
ref_tracks <- tracks_interp %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier) %>%
  filter(year == min(year)) %>%
  rename(lon_ref = lon)

# 6. Comparaison
# On enlève les comparaisons des années avec elles-mêmes
comparison <- tracks_interp %>%
  left_join(ref_tracks,
            by = c("individual.local.identifier", "lat")) %>%
  filter(year.x != year.y) %>%   # on enlève les comparaisons identiques
  mutate(
    delta_lon = lon - lon_ref
  )
comparison

# delta_lon > 0
# l’oiseau est plus à l’est que lors de l’année de référence

# delta_lon < 0
# l’oiseau est plus à l’ouest

# delta_lon = 0
# même trajectoire qu’au départ
```

### Indice de régularité par individu

```{r}
# Construire l'indice
regularity_index_spring <- comparison %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, year.x, year.y, age_group.x) %>%
  summarise(
    reg = mean(abs(delta_lon), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
regularity_index_spring

# On enlève les regularity_index_spring des années avec elles-mêmes
regularity_index_spring <- regularity_index_spring %>%
  filter(year.x != year.y)
regularity_index_spring
```

### Représentation

```{r}
# Enlever les id fantômes
regularity_index_spring <- regularity_index_spring %>%
  mutate(individual.local.identifier = droplevels(individual.local.identifier))
unique(regularity_index_spring$individual.local.identifier)

# Ajouter une colonne ID à regularity_index_spring
regularity_index_spring <- regularity_index_spring %>%
  mutate(ID = if_else(
    word(individual.local.identifier, 1) == "La",
    word(individual.local.identifier, 2),
    word(individual.local.identifier, 1)
  ))
regularity_index_spring$ID <- as.factor (regularity_index_spring$ID)
unique(regularity_index_spring$ID)

# Plot par ID
plot(regularity_index_spring$reg ~ regularity_index_spring$ID)
# Plot par age_group
plot(regularity_index_spring$reg ~ regularity_index_spring$age_group.x)
```

## Modèles régularité

```{r}
# Regroupement avec colonne saison
regularity_index_all <- bind_rows(
  regularity_index_spring %>% mutate(season = "spring"),
  regularity_index_autumn %>% mutate(season = "autumn")
)
# Modèle linéaire
lm_reg0 <- lm(reg ~ 1, data = regularity_index_all)
lm_reg1 <- lm(reg ~ age_group.x + season, data = regularity_index_all)
lm_reg2 <- lm(reg ~ age_group.x + season + age_group.x:season, data = regularity_index_all)
summary(lm_reg0);summary(lm_reg1);summary(lm_reg2)

AIC (lm_reg0, lm_reg1, lm_reg2) # lm reg 1

# lme
lme_reg1 <- lmer(reg ~ age_group.x + season + (1|ID), data = regularity_index_all)
summary(lme_reg1)
lme_reg2 <- lmer(reg ~ age_group.x + season + age_group.x : season + (1|ID), data = regularity_index_all)
summary(lme_reg2) # Intéraction NS -> Représentation du modèle sans intéraction?
```

## Représentation des prédictions

### lme avec interaction

```{r}
summary(lme_reg2)

library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

pred <- ggpredict(lme_reg2, terms = c("season", "age_group.x"))

ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_jitter(data = regularity_index_all,
              aes(x = season, y = reg, color = age_group.x),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05, dodge.width = 0.2),
              alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.7,
                position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = group),
            linewidth = 0.8,
            position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("adult" = "#5b9bd5", "juvenile" = "#d4845a"),
                     labels = c("Adulte", "Juvénile")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("adult" = "solid", "juvenile" = "dashed"),
                        labels = c("Adulte", "Juvénile")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("autumn" = "Autumn", "spring" = "Spring")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Regularity index ~ age_group and season",
    subtitle = "Predicted values ± 95% CI | age_group: p = 0.047 * | season: ns | interaction: ns",
    x        = "Season",
    y        = "Regularity index",
    color    = "Age group",
    linetype = "Age group"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey50")
  )



summary(lme_reg2)

library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(stringr)

# Grille de prédiction avec IC
pred <- ggpredict(lme_reg2, terms = c("season", "age_group.x"))

# Renommer pour clarté
new_data_reg <- as.data.frame(pred)
colnames(new_data_reg)[colnames(new_data_reg) == "x"]     <- "season"
colnames(new_data_reg)[colnames(new_data_reg) == "group"] <- "age_group"

# Compression numérique de l'axe x (même trick que pour distances)
new_data_reg$season_num <- ifelse(new_data_reg$season == "autumn", 0, 0.22)
regularity_index_all$season_num <- ifelse(regularity_index_all$season == "autumn", 0, 0.22)
```
